# Contributing to bini-vault

## Start with the correct application

Use a maintained Node.js version with built-in fetch (Node.js 24 is used by the maintenance checks). Run `npm ci`, copy `.env.example` to `.env`, configure the required public Google Sheets source IDs/GIDs, and run `npm start`. Open http://localhost:3000; PORT can change this. `npm run dev` uses Node watch mode.

## Keep changes reviewable

Describe the observed problem and the behavior after your change. Keep one concern per pull request; avoid unrelated dependency updates and formatting churn. Read existing repository instructions before changing source.

## Verification

Run `python3 scripts/source-preflight.py` once available. Start the server and check `GET /api/health` independently of upstream catalogs, then `GET /api/source-health` and a small `GET /api/videos?page=1&limit=2` request. A healthy process does not prove every sheet or video host is available. No test/build script is declared in package.json.

For browser changes, check 390 × 844, 768 × 1024 and 1440 × 900 viewports. Look for horizontal overflow, clipped controls, readable text and keyboard focus. Record the actual browser and dimensions; a screenshot alone does not prove the whole journey.

Useful end-to-end check: Open the archive, search/filter, load another page, save an item to My List, reload, and check playback for a permitted fixture link. Verify a missing source or unavailable video produces an understandable state.

## Handle sensitive data

Never attach personal watch history, local-storage dumps or private spreadsheet content. Catalogs must be public as intended. Redact sensitive links and screenshots.

## Before opening a pull request

- Explain what changed and why.
- List commands actually run and their results; state skipped checks explicitly.
- Include reproducible steps for bug fixes and relevant screenshots for UI changes.
- Describe migration or rollback needs when changing persisted data.

tasks.title: Add dependency-free source syntax checks and CI

files..github/workflows/source-preflight.yml:
name: Source preflight
on:
  push:
    paths: ['**/*.js', '**/*.mjs', '**/*.cjs', '**/*.py', '**/*.html', '.github/workflows/source-preflight.yml']
  pull_request:
    paths: ['**/*.js', '**/*.mjs', '**/*.cjs', '**/*.py', '**/*.html', '.github/workflows/source-preflight.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: source-preflight-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  syntax:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - run: python3 scripts/source-preflight.py

# bini-vault: troubleshooting and recovery

## Scope

This guide describes the checked-in application as reviewed on 2026-10-10. Confirm current source and deployment configuration before operating on live data.

## Local setup

Use a maintained Node.js version with built-in fetch (Node.js 24 is used by the maintenance checks). Run `npm ci`, copy `.env.example` to `.env`, configure the required public Google Sheets source IDs/GIDs, and run `npm start`. Open http://localhost:3000; PORT can change this. `npm run dev` uses Node watch mode.

## Diagnose the failing boundary

Use /api/health to check the server, /api/source-health for catalog status and /api/videos for actual browsing. SOURCE_*_ID values identify spreadsheets, while SOURCE_*_GID values identify tabs; they are not interchangeable. My List and watch progress are browser-local, not backed up by the Node server. Validate CSV column names and public sharing when a catalog is empty. The /api/frame route requires FFmpeg; basic browsing does not prove frame extraction is available. Rate-limited clients should honor Retry-After rather than repeatedly refreshing.

## Safe verification

Run `python3 scripts/source-preflight.py` once available. Start the server and check `GET /api/health` independently of upstream catalogs, then `GET /api/source-health` and a small `GET /api/videos?page=1&limit=2` request. A healthy process does not prove every sheet or video host is available. No test/build script is declared in package.json.

Run `python3 scripts/check-local-setup.py` for a local configuration check (or static HTTP check for photobooth). This does not authenticate to remote providers or launch an application workload.

## Reproduce before changing data

Open the archive, search/filter, load another page, save an item to My List, reload, and check playback for a permitted fixture link. Verify a missing source or unavailable video produces an understandable state.

Use fixture data and an isolated deployment. Keep the last working revision available. Record the runtime, affected route/provider and error status before retrying. Do not repeatedly retry a rate-limited upstream.

## Information safe to share

Never attach personal watch history, local-storage dumps or private spreadsheet content. Catalogs must be public as intended. Redact sensitive links and screenshots.

## After a recovery

Recheck the failing journey and one normal journey, confirm that persisted/browser-local data is still available where expected, and document any steps that could not be exercised.
